Mixed watch, nods to the cargo team
It was a good run

Steady care at Aurelia Skyways

This week the Companion Animal Travel Desk saw calm handoffs, patient check-ins, and plenty of small wins for travelers and pets alike. Staff kept the tone steady, helped nervous flyers settle in, and made sure each journey felt shared from first arrival to final pickup. <<FACT F017>> The same careful approach carried through the lounge and across the concourse, where clear updates and kind voices made a real difference for families on the move.

We also heard good feedback on the pet lounge at Vellmar. <<FACT F002>> That kind of coordination keeps the desk grounded and gives travelers confidence that every step is being handled with care. Thanks to everyone who stayed alert, stayed gentle, and helped Aurelia Skyways keep the experience reassuring from start to finish.
